name: unify
description: Run Unify's GTM agent from Codex to build company and people lists, enrich emails and phone numbers, and launch sequences and tasks.

interface.longDescription: Skills and tools for driving Unify's go-to-market agent: discover companies and people, enrich contact data, and run outreach sequences and tasks from your coding agent. Long-running runs report progress and relay the agent's clarifying questions back to you before continuing.
defaultPrompt: Find target accounts that match my ICP.
Enrich these contacts with verified work emails.
Draft an outreach sequence for these prospects.
